utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: there are times when i have palpitations and a little shortness of breath.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: i don't know if it's got to do with the back pain.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: have you changed lifestyle, like exercising more or having allergies?

detail_list.summary: The patient reports shortness of breath and palpitations during mild exercise or walking.
The patient asks if her shortness of breath is related to her chronic back pain.
The doctor asks if the patient has changed her lifestyle, increased exercise, or has allergies.
The patient reports she has been exercising more.
